QFEP_Introduction.hero: the grabbable terms — abstraction that survives being picked up
QFEP_Introduction.anti: the formula-as-authority — the unifier you're told to memorize
QFEP_Introduction.tension: recognized, not learned: every term redeems experience the walker already owns — but a formula that unifies everything arrives after Gödel on purpose, held firmly and ready to be put down

QFEP_F_Term.hero: the snap-click — prediction error falling in your hands
QFEP_F_Term.anti: the dark room — the one place a prediction never fails
QFEP_F_Term.tension: F's optimum is death: the drive toward order is pleasant (the puzzles make you complicit), and its logical end is the room where nothing will ever happen again

QFEP_E_Term.hero: the microstate counter — entropy as the size of the possibility space
QFEP_E_Term.anti: dissolution — freedom's loss wearing freedom's clothes
QFEP_E_Term.tension: entropy is freedom, but choice requires a chooser: pure chaos and pure order fail symmetrically — the crystal has no future, the static has no self to have one

QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum.hero: the walkway — your position IS the parameter
QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum.anti: the diagram — the edge admired from outside, pinned and finished
QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum.tension: the curriculum re-walked in forty meters: the edge is findable by feel, and the skill (not the fact) is the point — locating criticality from inside, ready for systems without walkways

QFEP_Phi_Term.hero: the φ slider crossed at zero — a stance toward change
QFEP_Phi_Term.anti: the rigid sculpture — every deviation treated as damage
QFEP_Phi_Term.tension: the political term: same λ, opposite disposition — queer names the system that uses perturbation as material, and the thesis goes on record that life requires φ > 0, without making preservation a villain

QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos.hero: the dwelling — criticality inhabited, not crossed
QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos.anti: the locked slider — curated criticality, the edge found FOR you
QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos.tension: three literatures, one address (Langton, Kauffman, Beggs & Plenz) — but real systems get no lock; the harder question is deferred to the walker: how to stay near the edge when nothing holds the parameter still

QFEP_Sandbox.hero: the tuning hand — λ=0.35 vs 0.45 known by feel
QFEP_Sandbox.anti: the recitation — the formula known declaratively, and dead
QFEP_Sandbox.tension: understanding as capacity, not declaration: no wrong answers but still dead ones, and the definite article dissolves — Langton's edge, the reactor's edge, YOUR edge

QFEP_Synthesis.anti: the conclusion — the formula closed, filed, and finished
QFEP_Synthesis.tension: commencement, not conclusion: the formula handed over as a lens (usable, not crystal-true), and the specimen refuses taxonomy because refusing it is how it stays alive

CriticalAlgorithms_Algorithmic_Bias_Visu.hero: the divided room — allocation you feel in your legs
CriticalAlgorithms_Algorithmic_Bias_Visu.anti: “objectivity” — the training data deciding by not deciding
CriticalAlgorithms_Algorithmic_Bias_Visu.tension: bias is incompleteness's social form: classification requires an outside, and the system is consistent BECAUSE it chose what not to see — you audit from inside the space you were trained on

CriticalAlgorithms_Applied_Ethics.hero: the calibration slider — a dial with no neutral position
CriticalAlgorithms_Applied_Ethics.anti: ethics as postprocessing — the filter bolted onto a finished model
CriticalAlgorithms_Applied_Ethics.tension: ethics is the shape of the room, not a step in the pipeline; you will classify anyway, so the responsible act is to keep the outside on its panel and the hand on the dial visible

SpeculativeComputation_Paraconsistent_En.hero: the four-valued engine — holds P and not-P, keeps answering
SpeculativeComputation_Paraconsistent_En.anti: the principle of explosion — one contradiction proves anything
SpeculativeComputation_Paraconsistent_En.tension: give up explosion instead of giving up the world: contradiction as a load to carry (annotated, scoped) rather than an emergency to purge — Florensky's sphere wired into production

SpeculativeComputation_Situated_Computat.hero: the three platforms — the view with an address
SpeculativeComputation_Situated_Computat.anti: the god-trick — the view from everywhere and nowhere
SpeculativeComputation_Situated_Computat.tension: objectivity redefined as the careful accounting of the perspective you occupy; the view from a body can be interrogated, the view from nowhere cannot even be found

SpeculativeComputation_Collective_Knowle.hero: the mediation station — disagreement recorded as data
SpeculativeComputation_Collective_Knowle.anti: the single complete system — the proof that covers everything
SpeculativeComputation_Collective_Knowle.tension: consistent vs corrigible: the commons pools incompleteness instead of fleeing it — each system's outside is another's inside, and Gödel's shadow gets redistributed where it can be worked on

SpeculativeComputation_Rhizome_Network.hero: the rootless cave — any point connects to any other
SpeculativeComputation_Rhizome_Network.anti: the tree — root, trunk, and the privileged path
SpeculativeComputation_Rhizome_Network.tension: the rhizome does not overcome hierarchy, it never needed one — stronger than rebellion, which still orbits the tree it opposes; connection without permission

AdvancedLaboratory_Lab_Equipment_Simulat.hero: the MolecularDesigner — build the molecule that holds
AdvancedLaboratory_Lab_Equipment_Simulat.anti: the void pit — the substrate beneath the regulation benches
AdvancedLaboratory_Lab_Equipment_Simulat.tension: formal systems, with humility: every order rests on what it cannot formalize, and post-crisis practice is Melencolia's angel standing up — build anyway, with the void in view

PostCrisis_Synthesis.tension: the crisis was mathematics growing up, not failing; the practices are not compromises but what becomes possible once completeness is withdrawn — the edge is not the limit, the edge is the ground
